resources.string: Accept cards with Stripe Tap to Pay
Requires Android 13 or newer with NFC
Adds a Card tab at checkout. Money is paid out by Stripe to your own Stripe account.
Saved. Enter a new key to replace it.

In your Stripe Dashboard:
1. Developers → API keys → Create restricted key. Give it only "Terminal Connection Tokens: Write".
2. Terminal → Locations → create a location for this shop and copy its ID.
Use a separate key for each phone so you can revoke one if a device is lost.
Checks the key and location with Stripe
Enter a restricted key starting with rk_live_ or rk_test_. Secret keys (sk_…) are not accepted.
Enter a Terminal Location ID starting with tml_
Could not store the key securely on this device
Deletes the key from this phone and turns card payments off
Couldn\'t confirm the card payment. Tap the button to check its status; the card won\'t be charged twice.
A card payment went through after checkout closed. It has been added to your payment history.
The card was also charged for a sale that was already paid. Refund it in your Stripe Dashboard.
Card amount unavailable: the bitcoin price in %1$s is not loaded yet
